applies_to: paper exhibits filed with motions
requirement: hard 8.5 x 11 separator with the tab extending below the bottom of the page
quote: Each paper exhibit must be separated by a hard 8½ x 11 sheet with hard paper or plastic tabs extending below the bottom of the page, bearing the exhibit designation.

applies_to: paper copies of cited authorities the judge requires
requirement: tabbed as in rule 3.1110(f)(3)
quote: If in paper form, the authority must be tabbed or separated as required by rule 3.1110(f)(3).

jurisdiction: California Court of Appeal and Supreme Court
applies_to: documents supporting a writ petition, paper form
requirement: index tabs by number or letter
quote: If submitted in paper form, they must be index-tabbed by number or letter.

applies_to: documents supporting a writ petition, paper form
requirement: index tabs by number or letter
quote: If submitted in paper form, they must be index-tabbed by number or letter.

jurisdiction: New York Supreme and County Courts
applies_to: trial exhibit binder when the court directs one
requirement: plaintiff numbered, defendant lettered
quote: Plaintiff's exhibits shall be numerically tabbed, and defendant's exhibits shall be tabbed alphabetically.

applies_to: paper records
requirement: alphabetic tabs from A, right side; electronic records use Tab A separator sheets; filings pre-punched with two holes along the top, 2.75 in apart (2.3(c)(8))
quote: parties should use alphabetic tabs, commencing with the letter "A." The tabs should be affixed to the right side of the pages.

applies_to: appeal and motion packages
requirement: paper separator sheets preferred; if tabs, alphabetic and permanent
quote: the Board prefers that parties use alphabetic tabs of a permanent nature to avoid confusion.

applies_to: paper appendix or paper record in an original proceeding
requirement: tabbed and indexed; electronic versions bookmarked
quote: A paper record in an original proceeding or a paper appendix must be tabbed and indexed.

applies_to: unbound copy of an appendix
requirement: separator page before each document, no protruding tabs
quote: The unbound copy of an appendix must contain a separate page before each document and must not include tabs that extend beyond the edge of the page.

applies_to: brief appendix
requirement: extruding (protruding) tabs
quote: The items in the appendix shall be separated by appropriate extruding tabs.

applies_to: unbound copy
requirement: separator pages instead of tabs
quote: The unbound copy shall replace extruding tabs with separator pages.

applies_to: paper appendix
requirement: indexing tabs staggered top to bottom along the right side, numbered by district court docket number
quote: Indexing tabs shall be affixed to the first page of each document in the appendix to identify and assist in locating the document.

applies_to: record on appeal, civil appeals (district clerk)
requirement: right-side staggered tabs with docket numbers
quote: Tabs should be visible and staggered in sequence from top to bottom along the right-hand side.

applies_to: paper clerk's record (district clerk)
requirement: each document tabbed with its docket number
quote: Papers shall be bound in a volume or volumes with each document individually tabbed showing the number corresponding to the district court docket entry.

applies_to: appendix
requirement: tabs permitted
quote: Tabs may be used to separate documents in the appendix.

applies_to: trial exhibits
requirement: binder, tabbed, numbered, indexed
quote: the party intending to offer exhibits at trial shall place them in a binder, properly tabbed, numbered, and indexed

applies_to: exhibits, when more than 5
requirement: binder, tabbed, numbered, indexed
quote: the party intending to offer such exhibits shall place them in a binder, properly tabbed, numbered and indexed

applies_to: witness exhibit binders
requirement: tab numbers match the exhibit list; three-ring binder
quote: Each exhibit in the witness binder must be tabbed with the number of the exhibit as designated on the Exhibit List.

applies_to: exhibits to a motion, memorandum or brief, when more than 5
requirement: tabbed and indexed
quote: the exhibits shall be tabbed and indexed, with cross-references to the page numbers that relate to each exhibit.

applies_to: paper record excerpts
requirement: tabbed to match the table of contents numbers
quote: The record excerpts must: … (c) Be tabbed to correspond to the numbers assigned in the table of contents;

jurisdiction: U.S. Court of Appeals, Federal Circuit
applies_to: attachments or exhibits to a motion, response or reply
requirement: table of contents, then pages numbered or each exhibit separately tabbed
quote: Attachments or exhibits to a motion, response, or reply must be preceded by a table of contents and must be paginated or separately tabbed for ease of reference.

applies_to: hearing or trial exhibits, when more than 15
requirement: binder, tabbed, numbered, indexed
quote: Whenever the number of exhibits in any case to be presented at hearing or trial by either party exceeds fifteen (15), the party intending to offer such exhibits must tab, number, and index them in a binder.

jurisdiction: Pike County Court of Common Pleas, Pennsylvania
applies_to: exhibits attached to any filing
requirement: every exhibit tabbed and labeled
quote: All exhibits attached shall be tabbed and labeled.

jurisdiction: Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas, Trial Division–Civil
applies_to: legal papers filed on paper (scanned)
requirement: exhibit separator pages instead of tabs
quote: to avoid scanning errors, Exhibit separator pages must be used instead of Exhibit tabs.

applies_to: exhibits on a judge's courtesy copy (filed exhibits use cover pages)
requirement: tabbed dividers on courtesy copies; cover page between filed exhibits
quote: Exhibits attached to a judge’s courtesy copy must include tabbed dividers.

applies_to: hard-copy exhibits in contested matters and adversary proceedings
requirement: marked, tabbed, in a 3-ring or lay-flat binding
quote: All hard copy exhibits should be clearly marked, tabbed and bound in a 3-ring notebook or utilizing another binding method that allows the exhibit book to open and lay flat on an even surface.

jurisdiction: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, D. South Dakota
applies_to: hearing or trial exhibits, when more than 6
requirement: binders, indexed, tabbed
quote: If a party intends to offer more than six exhibits, the original exhibits and all copies of those exhibits shall, to the extent possible, be organized in binders, indexed, and tabbed.

applies_to: exhibits to the judge's copy of any filing
requirement: exhibits tabbed
quote: Exhibits to the judge’s copy must be tabbed.

applies_to: trial exhibits in paper booklet form
requirement: each exhibit tabbed, numbered, indexed; tabbed copies to each party 5 days before trial
quote: Exhibits shall be separately tabbed and identified in numerical order, and shall be indexed at the front of each exhibit book or books.

applies_to: pretrial exhibit copies for opposing counsel and chambers
requirement: premarked, separated by tabs, 7 days before final pretrial or trial
quote: Copies of the exhibits, premarked and separated by tabs, must be furnished to opposing counsel and submitted to the respective Judge’s chambers in accordance with chambers procedures at least 7 days before the final pretrial conference or trial (if no final pretrial is requested).

applies_to: paper originals
requirement: no protruding tabs; bold-type separator sheet instead
quote: A paper original shall not have protruding tabs.

applies_to: attachments to paper filings
requirement: blank separator sheet with the label printed on it
quote: Attachments may not be tabbed; reference characters should be printed or typed on a blank sheet of paper separating each attached document.

applies_to: paper originals (court and opposing copies should be tabbed)
requirement: no tabs on the original; dividers or tabs on voluminous copies
quote: When filed by paper, original documents offered for filing shall not include tabs or dividers.

applies_to: paper exhibits to filed documents, including the mandatory chambers copy
requirement: exhibits tabbed in sequential order
quote: The exhibit number must be placed immediately above or below the page number on each page of the exhibit. Exhibits must be tabbed in sequential order.

applies_to: separately bound exhibit appendix (exhibits over 100 pages); paper chambers copies of filings over 50 pages
requirement: each appendix exhibit tabbed; chambers copies tabbed and indexed
quote: The appendix must be bound on the left and must include a table of contents identifying each exhibit and, if applicable, the volume number. Each exhibit must be tabbed.

applies_to: paper courtesy copy of dispositive motion papers, when the court requires one
requirement: exhibits properly tabbed, papers firmly bound
quote: Any exhibits must be properly tabbed and all papers firmly bound as required by LCivR 10.2.

applies_to: state-court documents attached to a notice of removal filed on paper
requirement: each document individually tabbed, in state-court filing-date order
quote: (if filed on paper, each document must be individually tabbed and arranged in chronological order according to the state court file date; if filed by electronic means, each document must be filed as a separate attachment)

applies_to: hearing and trial exhibits tendered in booklet format
requirement: separated by tabs or other dividers; at least one copy digital
quote: (C) if tendered in booklet format, separated by tabs or other appropriate dividers;

applies_to: chambers copies of motion exhibits, when required; trial and evidentiary hearing exhibit copies
requirement: indexing tabs; trial exhibit copies numbered, bound and tabbed
quote: If required, chamber’s copies of exhibits attached to papers must have indexing tabs.

applies_to: paper copy of the state-court record appendix in a death-sentence habeas case
requirement: tabbed paper copy, bound by volume, tabs matching the index
quote: Florida’s attorney general must bind by volume and promptly deliver to the proper division a tabbed paper copy of the index, the appendix, and each supplemental appendix. The tabs must correspond to the index.

applies_to: proofs of claim delivered to chambers for a substantive claim objection
requirement: claims in a binder separated by tabs, extra tabs between exhibits
quote: The proofs of claim must be in a binder and separated by tabs

applies_to: trial exhibits and the exhibit cover sheet
requirement: three-ring notebooks, each exhibit separated by a divider or tab with its number or letter
quote: Unless otherwise directed by the court, the exhibit cover sheet and exhibits shall be submitted in three-ring notebooks with each exhibit separated by dividers or tabs corresponding to the exhibit number or letter.

applies_to: copies of trial exhibits and depositions delivered to the clerk for the judge
requirement: cover page listing the exhibits, exhibits separated by tabs
quote: The copy must contain a cover page listing the exhibits and the exhibits must be separated by tabs.

jurisdiction: Hawaiʻi Supreme Court and Intermediate Court of Appeals
applies_to: documents and briefs filed on paper
requirement: not bound, stapled or tabbed
quote: Conventionally filed documents shall be submitted on unruled, unglazed, opaque white paper and shall not be bound, stapled, or tabbed.

jurisdiction: U.S. District Court, D. New Hampshire
applies_to: conventionally filed paper appendix or attachment with more than one exhibit
requirement: table of contents or index; each exhibit separately numbered with a separate tab page
quote: When a conventionally filed paper appendix or attachment includes more than one exhibit, it shall also include a table of contents or index, and each exhibit shall be separately numbered and marked with a separate tab page.

applies_to: state-court record filed in capital habeas corpus cases
requirement: record assembled in the rule's category order, separated by tabs per category
quote: The record shall be assembled in the following order and shall be separated by tabs according to the following categories:

applies_to: paper appendices (excerpts of record); e-filers use separate PDFs
requirement: documents divided by tabs; table of contents lists tab and page (a 2026 proposal would remove the paper-tab requirement)
quote: Documents in a paper appendix shall be divided by tabs.

applies_to: original paper documents filed in the Supreme Court of Ohio
requirement: no staples or binding, no dividers or tabs
quote: The original shall not be stapled or otherwise bound and shall not contain dividers or tabs.

applies_to: documents submitted in paper format
requirement: no tabs, colored sheets, binding or staples
quote: Documents should not contain tabs, colored sheets of paper, or binding and should not be stapled.

applies_to: documents submitted for filing on paper
requirement: no tabs; a separate page printed with the exhibit number or letter instead
quote: Documents may not include tabs; exhibits should be separated using a separate page with the identification of the exhibit number or letter printed on the page.

applies_to: paper set of exhibits for the witness at a hearing or trial
requirement: more than 10 exhibits: tabbed, in a three-ring binder
quote: if there are more than 10 exhibits, the paper exhibits must be tabbed and presented in a three-ring binder.

jurisdiction: U.S. District Court, D. Puerto Rico
applies_to: appendices, exhibits and attachments to motions filed conventionally with leave
requirement: table of contents or index; each exhibit separately numbered and marked with a tab
quote: When an appendix or attachment includes more than one exhibit, it shall also include a table of contents or index, and each exhibit shall be separately numbered and marked with a tab.

applies_to: prior state or federal court record submitted in death-penalty habeas corpus cases
requirement: colored, numbered index tabs: red P-1 for petitioner, blue R-1 for respondent, green X-1 for others
quote: Petitioner shall use red index tabs and shall sequentially number the index tabs commencing with the number “P-1,” “P-2,” etc.

jurisdiction: U.S. District Court, W.D. New York
applies_to: state-court documents attached to a notice of removal
requirement: index plus each document individually tabbed, in chronological order
quote: each document filed and/or served in the state court action, individually tabbed and arranged in chronological order

jurisdiction: Armed Services Board of Contract Appeals
rule: ASBCA Rule 4(c) (48 CFR ch. 2, App. A)
applies_to: Rule 4 appeal file in a contract appeal (government file and appellant's supplement)
requirement: documents in chronological order, tabbed with sequential numbers, indexed; 3-ring binders with tab numbers on the front and spine label
quote: Documents in the appeal file may be originals or legible copies, and shall be arranged in chronological order where practicable, tabbed with sequential numbers, and indexed to identify the contents of the file.

applies_to: appellant's appeal file in a grant appeal (except expedited cases)
requirement: documents tabbed, in chronological order, with an indexed list
quote: An appeal file containing the documents supporting the claim, tabbed and organized chronologically and accompanied by an indexed list identifying each document.

applies_to: hearing exhibits
requirement: multiple exhibits indexed and tabbed; multipage exhibits paginated lower right
quote: Multiple exhibits shall be indexed and tabbed.

jurisdiction: FAA Office of Dispute Resolution for Acquisition
applies_to: documents accompanying the FAA Product Team's response to a bid protest
requirement: chronologically indexed, individually tabbed, certified
quote: The Product Team response shall cite to and be accompanied by all relevant documents, which shall be chronologically indexed, individually tabbed, and certified as authentic and complete.

applies_to: exhibits to a Special Counsel disciplinary action complaint
requirement: exhibits or attachments numbered and tabbed
quote: The Special Counsel must file a copy of the complaint, together with numbered and tabbed exhibits or attachments, if any, and a certificate of service listing each party or the party's representative.

applies_to: Rule 4 appeal file and supplements in a legislative-branch contract appeal
requirement: 3-ring binders no wider than 4 inches, a tab for each document, indexed by date, description, tab and Bates number
quote: Within each binder, tabs shall separate each document; multiple documents shall not be placed behind a single tab, unless each document is separated by a divider.

applies_to: paper submissions, allowed only when electronic filing is down or in extraordinary circumstances
requirement: no tabs extending past the page edges; dividers without extruding tabs, same size and weight paper
quote: If a paper submission contains dividers, the dividers must not have any extruding tabs or other devices, and must be on the same size and weight paper as the submission;

jurisdiction: HHS / SAMHSA opioid treatment program certification review
applies_to: review file in an appeal of an opioid treatment program or accreditation body suspension or revocation
requirement: documents tabbed, in chronological order, with an index
quote: A review file containing the documents supporting appellant's argument, tabbed and organized chronologically, and accompanied by an index identifying each document.

jurisdiction: HHS Departmental Appeals Board ALJs (CMS civil money penalty hearings)
applies_to: respondent's proposed hearing exhibits in a CMS civil money penalty appeal
requirement: supporting documents tabbed, in chronological order, with an indexed list
quote: All documents (including any affidavits) supporting its arguments, tabbed and organized chronologically and accompanied by an indexed list identifying each document (respondent's proposed hearing exhibits).

jurisdiction: Commodity Futures Trading Commission (appeals of NFA decisions)
applies_to: record of the proceeding the National Futures Association files with the Commission
requirement: record bound as a unit, chronologically indexed and tabbed, certified
quote: The record shall be bound as a unit, chronologically indexed and tabbed

applies_to: paper filings with the Board (copies with workpapers or expert witness testimony must be tabbed)
requirement: no divider tabs on the original; divider tabs required on copies that include workpapers or expert testimony
quote: Original documents may not include divider tabs, but copies must if workpapers or expert witness testimony are submitted.

jurisdiction: FAA commercial space civil penalty adjudications (DOT)
applies_to: original paper documents filed with the DOT docket in part 406 civil penalty cases
requirement: no tabs on the original; copies for the judge and other parties may have them
quote: The original has no tabs. The copy that is filed or sent to the administrative law judge or Assistant Chief Counsel for Litigation, and the copy served on another party, need not meet this specification.

jurisdiction: U.S. Department of Transportation, aviation economic proceedings
applies_to: original documents filed with DOT Dockets under part 302
requirement: originals not bound or tabbed, unless an administrative law judge's order sets other filing rules
quote: Original documents may not be bound in any form or include tabs, except in cases assigned by order to an Administrative Law Judge for hearing, in which case the filing requirements will be set by order.

applies_to: certified record a government unit files in response to a petition for review
requirement: documents in date order, numbered, with a numbered tab on the right or bottom edge of each document's first page
quote: The government unit shall (1) arrange the documents to be certified in chronological order, (2) number them, and (3) affix to the right or bottom edge of the first page of each document a tab showing the number of that document.

jurisdiction: Washington Supreme Court and Court of Appeals
applies_to: documents filed in hard copy
requirement: no tabs, colored sheets, binding or staples
quote: Documents should not contain tabs, colored sheets of paper, or binding and should not be stapled.

applies_to: appellant's brief appendix and any supplemental appendix
requirement: table of contents and plain paper tabs; plastic-coated tabs not allowed
quote: Any supplemental appendix shall include a table of contents, and each document shall be tabbed using plain paper tabs and not plastic-coated tabs.

applies_to: exhibits, declarations and affidavits, on originals and mandatory chambers copies
requirement: appropriately labeled tabs; cover sheets not allowed in place of tabs
quote: Original documents and Mandatory Chambers Copies (see LR10.3) of exhibits, declarations, and affidavits shall have appropriately labeled tabs.

applies_to: exhibits to civil filings
requirement: tabs optional; if used, at the bottom, not the sides
quote: If exhibits are tabbed, the tabs must be at the bottom and not at the sides.

applies_to: state-court record filed by the respondent in a first capital habeas petition
requirement: each document individually tabbed and numbered consecutively, both copies
quote: Both copies of each document submitted under LR 81-3(i) must be individually tabbed and numbered consecutively.

applies_to: appendix to the appellant's brief
requirement: appendix sections tabbed
quote: Sections of the appendix shall be tabbed and salient information highlighted.

jurisdiction: Alabama Supreme Court and Courts of Appeals
applies_to: appendix to a petition for writ of mandamus or prohibition
requirement: a divider or tab between the petition and the appendix, and a divider and tab for each appendix document
quote: The appendix shall be separated from the petition by a divider or tab, and each document within the appendix shall be separated by a divider and appropriate tab to identify and assist in locating the documents.

applies_to: exhibits provided to the court for a trial or hearing
requirement: exhibits in notebooks, numbered in the lower right corner and tabbed with dividers
quote: Exhibits provided to the Court must be contained in a notebook or notebooks and be sequentially numbered in the lower right corner and tabbed with dividers.

applies_to: pleadings and other filed documents
requirement: no index tabs or divider sheets that extend past 8.5 x 11
quote: Index tab pages, separator sheets, cover sheets, and divider sheets for which any part is outside the 8 ½ inch by 11-inch paper size SHALL NOT be used.

applies_to: tabs or separators in any filed document; the judge's exhibit copies at trial
requirement: tabs at the bottom of the page only; more than ten exhibits go in a three-ring binder tabbed by exhibit number
quote: Any tabs or separators used within documents shall be placed at the bottom of the page only.

applies_to: trial exhibits, originals and bench copies
requirement: exhibits numbered by tabs or in the upper right-hand corner, in numerical order
quote: The exhibits should be numbered by either tabs or in the upper right-hand corner and organized in numerical order.

applies_to: bench copies for summary judgment and revision motions
requirement: bench copies in a tabbed binder
quote: All bench copies associated with Motions for Summary Judgment and Motions for Revision shall be provided in a tabbed binder.

applies_to: civil trial exhibits in the Joint Statement of the Evidence
requirement: exhibits in binders with numbered tabs, delivered at least seven days before trial
quote: At least seven days prior to trial, the parties shall deliver their exhibits contained in their Joint Statement of the Evidence in binders with numbered tabs for pretrial processing.

jurisdiction: Ferry, Pend Oreille and Stevens Counties Superior Court, Washington
applies_to: trial exhibits
requirement: separate original exhibit binders with tabbed exhibits and an index of proposed exhibits
quote: The parties and/or counsel shall prepare original separate exhibit binders containing tabbed exhibits and an index of proposed exhibits.

applies_to: administrative record in a Land Use Petition Act case
requirement: bench copy for the judge with an index and document tabs; the copy filed with the clerk without side tabs
quote: A bench copy of the record with an index and document identification tabs shall be provided to the assigned judge. A copy of the administrative record without side tabs shall be filed with the Superior Court Clerk for the court file.

jurisdiction: San Juan County Superior Court, Washington
applies_to: filed documents; the judge's courtesy copies and trial exhibit courtesy copies
requirement: no tabs on filed documents (the clerk discards them), separator pages instead; tabs allowed on courtesy copies, and trial exhibit courtesy copies go in a tabbed binder
quote: There shall be no tabs on filed documents. Exhibits or sections may be denoted or divided by a separator page. Any tabs included in a filed document will be discarded by the Clerk without notice to the party/counsel. Judge’s courtesy copies may contain tabs for ease of reference.

jurisdiction: Pierce County District Court, Washington (small claims)
applies_to: small claims evidence filed with the court
requirement: loose 8.5 x 11 pages, 100 pages at most; no binders or tabs
quote: Document filing is limited to 100 pages per case and all documents must be filed on 8½” x 11” paper. DO NOT include binders, page protectors, paper clips, staples, or tabs.

jurisdiction: U.S. District Court, D. Arizona (bankruptcy appeals)
applies_to: excerpts of the record in a bankruptcy appeal, the judge's paper copy
requirement: documents divided by tabs in the paper copy for the judge
quote: Documents in the excerpts shall be divided by tabs in the paper copy provided for use by the Judge.

applies_to: trial exhibits
requirement: each exhibit tabbed by its number or letter
quote: Parties must tab each exhibit by number or letter so that it may be easily referenced.

applies_to: paper-filed interlocutory and discretionary applications
requirement: record materials indexed and tabbed, a blank sheet between items
quote: Paper-filed applications shall include copies of all supporting materials from the record, indexed and tabbed with a blank sheet between each indexed item.

applies_to: required paper copies of a pleading with more than one attachment or appendix
requirement: a tabbed blank sheet before each attachment or appendix
quote: If a party attaches more than one attachment or appendix to a pleading, the party must separate the body of the brief and each attachment or appendix in any required paper copies with a tabbed blank sheet of paper.

applies_to: documents filed on paper (nonsystem documents), so they can be scanned
requirement: unbound, no external tabs or dividers
quote: in order for the Commission to scan a nonsystem document into the records management system, the document must: … (c) Not have external tabs or dividers

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of San Luis Obispo
applies_to: exhibits attached to any pleading or document filed with the court
requirement: a tab protruding at the bottom of each exhibit's first page
quote: The first page of each exhibit must be marked with a tab that protrudes from the page, at the bottom.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego
rule: S.D. Super. Ct. Local Rule 5.5.5(B)(2) and (C)(4)
applies_to: family law exhibits: copies for counsel, the judge and witnesses; lodged documents
requirement: tabs/dividers on working copies, no overhanging tabs on the filed copy; lodged documents tabbed to the notice of lodgment
quote: Lodged documents must be tabbed to correlate to the notice of intent to lodge documents and BATES stamped or numbered consecutively throughout the entirety of the lodgment.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Fresno
applies_to: appendix of out-of-state or Lexis/Westlaw authorities in civil matters
requirement: each authority tabbed and indexed as an exhibit under Cal. Rules of Court 3.1110(f)
quote: a copy of each authority shall be lodged in a separately bound appendix of authorities, and each authority shall be tabbed and indexed as an exhibit as required by California Rules of Court, rule 3.1110(f).

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Santa Cruz
rule: Santa Cruz Super. Ct. Local Rule 2.8.04
applies_to: documents submitted for filing
requirement: no tabs; a standard 8.5 x 11 separator sheet titled with the exhibit's sequence
quote: No tabs shall be included in any documents submitted for filing.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Ventura
applies_to: hard copy documents filed in eCourt case types (civil, probate, small claims, mental health, civil restraining orders)
requirement: no exhibit tabs or dividers past 8.5 x 11; exhibit number or letter in the footer of every page
quote: hard copy documents submitted for filing shall not include exhibit tabs or other dividers which cause the page to exceed ”8 ½ by 11”.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Santa Clara
rule: Santa Clara Super. Ct. Civil Local Rule 6(B), Criminal Rule 7(B)(3), Family Rule 1(H)(2)
applies_to: documents submitted for filing on paper (civil self-represented parties, criminal, family)
requirement: no tabs; exhibits separated by a standard size sheet titled with the exhibit's sequence
quote: Do not include tabs with any documents submitted for filing.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Sonoma
applies_to: original documents submitted for filing
requirement: no tabs on the original; exhibits separated by a standard 8.5 x 11 sheet titled with the exhibit's sequence
quote: No tabs shall be included in any original document submitted for filing.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of El Dorado
rule: El Dorado Super. Ct. Local Rule 7.10.02(E) and 8.20.03(D)
applies_to: civil motion exhibits; family law trial and long-cause evidentiary hearing exhibit binders
requirement: motion exhibits separately tabbed and numbered; family trial binders with tabbed separators, numbers for petitioner and letters for respondent
quote: All exhibits submitted in support of or in opposition to a motion shall be separately tabbed and identified numerically by the parties.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Shasta
rule: Shasta Super. Ct. Local Rule 5.19(D)(2) and (H)
applies_to: CEQA administrative record volumes and the petitioner's trial notebook
requirement: record binders of up to 300 pages numerically tabbed by document number; each trial notebook document separately tabbed
quote: Each volume shall consist of not more than three hundred (300) pages and shall be numerically tabbed by the document number in the volume.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Contra Costa
rule: Contra Costa Super. Ct. Local Rule 3.42(3)
applies_to: exhibits filed with civil motion papers
requirement: exhibits tabbed as Cal. Rules of Court 3.1110(f) requires (bookmarked if e-filed); monetary sanctions for missing tabs
quote: Counsel of record should take note the Court has and will continue to impose monetary sanctions on attorneys who file documents lacking proper tabs or bookmarks where required

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Napa
applies_to: courtesy copies of motions in limine, oppositions and declarations before the trial management conference
requirement: three-ring binders with a tab separating each motion and its related papers
quote: Said courtesy copies shall be submitted in one or more three-ring binder(s) with binder tabs separating each motion and document relating thereto.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Marin
applies_to: exhibits referenced in probate filings
requirement: every referenced exhibit tabbed
quote: All referenced exhibits must be properly tabbed for easy reference by the Court.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Trinity
rule: Trinity Super. Ct. Local Rule 4.16(D)(2) and (H)
applies_to: CEQA administrative record volumes and the petitioner's trial notebook (rules effective July 1, 2021, the current posted set)
requirement: record binders of up to 300 pages numerically tabbed by document number; each trial notebook document separately tabbed
quote: Each volume shall consist of not more than three hundred (300) pages and shall be numerically tabbed by the document number in the volume.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Plumas
applies_to: civil jury and bench trial exhibit binders and the joint trial binder
requirement: exhibit binders tabbed and paginated on the first day of trial; motions in limine tabbed in numerical order behind Tab B
quote: At least five sets of exhibit binders – tabbed and paginated – are required on the first day of trial: a complete set each for the court, the judicial assistant, and the witness.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Monterey
applies_to: courtesy hard-copy appendix of administrative record pages in administrative writs (CCP 1094.5)
requirement: appendix pages in numerical order, or tabbed if not
quote: The administrative record pages in the Appendix shall either be in numerical order, or if not in numerical order, tabbed.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Merced
applies_to: exhibits and attachments to criminal pretrial motions
requirement: the original and every copy of each exhibit tabbed, and cited in the papers by tab
quote: The original and all copies of exhibits and attachments shall be tabbed and shall be referred into the pleadings or papers by tab identification.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of San Benito
rule: San Benito Super. Ct. Local Rule 16.3(d)
applies_to: courtesy hard-copy appendix of administrative record pages in administrative writs (CCP 1094.5) (read from the July 1, 2026 redline, the rules the court posts)
requirement: appendix pages in numerical order, or tabbed if not
quote: The administrative record pages in the Appendix shall either be in numerical order, or if not in numerical order, tabbed.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Orange
applies_to: exhibits in civil default judgment packets; the joint trial notebook delivered to the trial department
requirement: each exhibit separated by a hard 8½ x 11 sheet with the tab below the page; the joint trial notebook tabbed
quote: Each exhibit must be separated by a hard 8 ½ x 11 sheet with hard paper or plastic tabs extending below the bottom of the page, bearing the exhibit designation.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles
rule: L.A. Super. Ct. Local Rules 5.27(c), 3.231(j) and (l)
applies_to: parentage judgment packets in gestational surrogacy cases; joint appendix and trial notebook in prerogative writ cases (rules effective January 1, 2022, the court's current set)
requirement: petitioner's documents tabbed 1, 2, 3 and respondent's A, B, C; side tabs between documents in a writ joint appendix; trial notebook documents separated by labelled tabs
quote: Petitioner’s documents must be tabbed and labeled as 1, 2, 3, etc. Respondent’s documents must be tabbed and labeled as A, B, C, etc.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Kings
rule: Kings Super. Ct. Local Rules 113 and 126(C)(5) (tabs required in motion in limine binders, Rule 311(B)(5))
applies_to: exhibits attached to pleadings, motions and declarations filed with the court
requirement: no exhibit tabs on filed papers, because they cannot be scanned; a single 8½ x 11 exhibit designation page instead; the motion in limine evidence binder is tabbed
quote: Since they cannot be easily scanned into the court’s electronic case management system, exhibit tabs should not be used to separate exhibits from pleadings, motions, declarations, or other documents.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of San Francisco
rule: S.F. Super. Ct. Local Rule 2.7.B (also 20.3.A, asbestos motions in limine)
applies_to: paper courtesy copies of any filed document requiring court review, action or signature
requirement: courtesy copies on paper, properly tabbed and bound; asbestos motion-in-limine courtesy copies in an indexed, tabbed binder
quote: Provide courtesy copies in paper format, properly tabbed and bound, to the appropriate department.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Sierra
applies_to: criminal pretrial motions citing authority other than California cases, statutes, constitutional provisions or state or local rules
requirement: a copy of each such authority attached to the papers and tabbed as an exhibit
quote: If any authority other than California cases, statutes, constitutional provisions or State or local rules is cited in any motion or memorandum of points and authorities, a copy shall be attached to the papers in which the authorities are cited and tabbed as exhibits.

jurisdiction: Nevada Eighth Judicial District Court (Clark County)
applies_to: exhibits attached to pleadings or papers, in a courtesy copy delivered to the judge's chambers
requirement: each exhibit divided by a tab; plaintiffs numbered, defendants lettered; exhibit number on an 8.5 x 11 sheet before each exhibit
quote: If a courtesy copy is delivered to the Judge’s chambers, all exhibits attached to pleadings or papers must be clearly divided by a tab. Plaintiffs must use numerical designations and defendants must use alphabetical designations.

jurisdiction: Nevada First Judicial District Court (Carson City and Storey County)
applies_to: exhibits attached to pleadings or papers or in an appendix, including copies; documents in a writ petition appendix
requirement: indexing tabs extending below the bottom of the pages so each exhibit number shows without thumbing through
quote: Exhibits attached to pleadings or papers or in an appendix, including copies, must have indexing tabs that extend below the bottom of the pages of the documents so each exhibit number can be clearly seen without having to thumb through the exhibits.

jurisdiction: Nevada Tenth Judicial District Court (Churchill County)
applies_to: exhibits attached to pleadings or papers or in an appendix, including copies
requirement: indexing tabs extending beyond the border of the pages so each exhibit number shows without thumbing through
quote: Exhibits attached to pleadings or papers or in an appendix, including copies, must have indexing tabs that extend beyond the border of the pages of the documents so each exhibit number can be clearly seen without having to thumb through the exhibits.

jurisdiction: Superior Court of California, County of Colusa
applies_to: misdemeanor pretrial motions and memoranda of points and authorities citing authority other than California cases, statutes, constitutional provisions or state or local rules (rules revised effective July 1, 2015, the current posted set)
requirement: a copy of each such authority, and of any California case not yet in the Advance Sheets, attached and tabbed as an exhibit
quote: If any authority other than California cases, statutes, constitutional provisions or State or local rules is cited in any Motion or Memorandum of Points and Authorities, a copy shall be attached to the papers in which the authorities are cited and tabbed as exhibits.

applies_to: applications for supervisory writs, the original and duplicates (rules as amended effective July 1, 2026)
requirement: pages numbered consecutively, never tabs in place of page numbers; no tabs or extensions outside the paper dimensions
quote: No tabs shall be used in lieu of consecutive page numbering and no tabs or extensions shall be placed outside the paper dimensions.

applies_to: exhibits attached to motion memoranda; the two file-stamped courtesy copies of motion papers delivered to the judge's chambers
requirement: labeled tabs on every attached exhibit; courtesy-copy exhibits tabbed
quote: All attached exhibits shall have appropriately labeled tabs.

applies_to: exhibits attached to probate petitions, responses and objections
requirement: labeled tabs on every attached exhibit
quote: All attached exhibits shall have appropriately labeled tabs.

rule: Alaska R. Civ. P. 43.1(h), Administrative Bulletin No. 9 § IV(I)
applies_to: trials with more than 50 documentary exhibits
requirement: exhibits submitted in an organized system; three-ring binders with tab dividers are one accepted way
quote: For example: documentary exhibits may be placed in 3-ring binders with tab dividers or in file folders marked with the exhibit numbers.

applies_to: exhibits attached to motion memoranda
requirement: labeled tab on every attached exhibit
quote: All attached exhibits shall have appropriately labeled tabs.

jurisdiction: U.S. District Courts, N.D. and S.D. Iowa
applies_to: the court's copy of trial exhibits; LR 10(c) bars tabs on documents filed on paper
requirement: all exhibits in three-ring tabbed binders at the start of trial; no tabs on paper filings
quote: Unless the court orders otherwise at the final pretrial conference, at the commencement of trial the parties must supply the court with a copy of all exhibits in three-ringed, tabbed binders.

applies_to: responses to requests for information (discovery) in Commission cases
requirement: bound, tabbed and indexed
quote: Responses to requests for information shall be appropriately bound, tabbed, and indexed.

applies_to: trial notebooks of exhibits in civil trials, one for the Court and one for the witnesses
requirement: each party's exhibits consecutively numbered and tabbed; deposition transcripts in one binder separated by divider tabs naming the deponent
quote: The attorneys for each party shall also submit two (2) trial notebooks, one (1) for the Court and one (1) for the witnesses, containing each party's exhibits, consecutively numbered and tabbed.

applies_to: chambers courtesy copy of motion exhibits over 50 pages
requirement: tabbed binders with an index helpful where exhibits are numerous
quote: Additionally, where exhibits are numerous, it is helpful to the Court to receive well-organized, tabbed binders of double-sided copies, along with an index or table of contents.

applies_to: courtesy paper copy of filings over 100 pages, when the Court requests one
requirement: binders or folders of 500 pages or less, tabbed if applicable
quote: The courtesy paper copy shall be placed in binders or folders not exceeding 500 pages each, clearly marked “Judge’s Courtesy Copy of Electronic Filing,” tabbed if applicable, and delivered to the Clerk of Court.

applies_to: legal papers presented in hard copy for scanning
requirement: exhibit separator pages instead of tabs
quote: To avoid scanning errors, exhibit separator pages must be used instead of exhibit tabs.

jurisdiction: Lehigh County Court of Common Pleas, Pennsylvania
applies_to: exhibits in documents filed with the Clerk of Courts (civil)
requirement: each exhibit identified at the bottom center and by an exhibit tab
quote: All exhibits shall be identified as such on the bottom center of each document as well as by exhibit tabs.

jurisdiction: Lancaster County Court of Common Pleas, Pennsylvania
applies_to: exhibits and appendices to legal papers (civil)
requirement: tabs at the bottom of every exhibit and appendix
quote: Tabs shall be placed at the bottom of all exhibits and appendices.

jurisdiction: Dauphin County Court of Common Pleas, Pennsylvania
applies_to: exhibits in pleadings filed with the Prothonotary (civil; Crim. L.R. 575(1)(f) has the same sentence)
requirement: exhibit tabs at the bottom of the pleading
quote: All exhibit tabs shall appear at the bottom of the pleading.

jurisdiction: Snyder and Union Counties Court of Common Pleas (17th Judicial District), Pennsylvania
applies_to: exhibits to pleadings and other legal papers
requirement: every exhibit tabbed and labeled
quote: All exhibits shall be tabbed and labeled.

jurisdiction: Butler County Court of Common Pleas (50th Judicial District), Pennsylvania
applies_to: trial exhibit book, when the presiding judge directs one
requirement: each party prepares a tabbed exhibit book before trial
quote: Each party shall prepare a tabbed exhibit book, in advance of trial, containing each exhibit the party plans to show to a witness, to introduce through a witness, or to otherwise proffer as evidence.
